blocks.arabic_text: مَا انْتَقَصَ مِنَ الْفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ يَكُونُ سَائِرُ عَمَلِهِ عَلَي ذلِكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال:هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ماجاءان اول مايحاسب به العبد يوم القيمةالصلاة...،رقم:٤١٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “On the Day of Qiyamah, of a person's deeds, the very first thing he will be asked about is Salah. If the Salah is in order, he will be successful and will attain his goal; if the Salah is not in order, he will fail and also suffer loss. If there is a deficiency in the Fard Salah, Allah will say to the angels, “Look whether My servant has any Nafl to make up the deficiencies of the Fard.” If there are Nafl, the deficiencies of the Fard will be completed with them. In the same way, the reckoning of the other deeds, such as fasting, Zakat and so on, will take place. (The deficiency in the Fard fasts will be completed through Nafl fasts, and the deficiency in Zakat will be completed through Nafl charity),” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ أَغْبَطَ أَوْلِيَائِي عِنْدِي لَمُؤْمِنٌ خَفِيفُ الْحَاذِ ذُوحَظٍّ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ، أَحْسَنَ عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ وَأَطَاعَهُ فِي السِّرِّ وَكَانَ غَامِضاً فِي النَّاسِ لَا يُشَارُ إِلَيْهِ بِاْلأَصَابِعِ، وَكَانَ رِزْقُهُ كَفَافاً فَصَبَرَ عَلَي ذلِكَ ثُمَّ نَقَرَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ فَقَالَ: عُجِّلَتْ مَنِيَّتُهُ قَلَّتْ بَوَاكِيهِ قَلَّ تُرَاثُهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن باب ماجاء في الكفاف ....، رقم:٢٣٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “A believer with a very light burden (one without worldly goods or the burden of a family), who has a great share in Salah (who prays Nafl Salah abundantly), who worships his Lord in the best manner, who obeys Allah in private too (just as he obeys Allah openly), who remains without fame among the people, who is not pointed out with fingers (who has not become famous among the people), who meets his needs with only
